STEP 2 - Vessel size:

b) Reference cue: the greens and pineapple chunks are roughly 2-3 cm across, and the plate spans about 4-5 times the length of the chicken mound. Taking the plate width as roughly 9-10 chicken-mound lengths of about 2.5 cm gives about 23-25 cm.
Reconciled width: about 24 cm square, so area ≈ 576 cm².

- Arugula/leafy greens: footprint about 30% of the plate, roughly 170 cm². Average thickness about 2 cm. Volume ≈ 340 ml. Raw leafy greens at 0.15 g/ml give about 50 g. Arugula is about 25 kcal/100 g.
- Pineapple chunks: about 4 visible pieces, roughly 15 g each, so about 60 g. Pineapple is about 50 kcal/100 g.
- Apple or pear slices: about 3 visible pieces, roughly 10 g each, so about 30 g. Apple is about 52 kcal/100 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: The chicken mound is a few layers deep and the greens sit on a flat base, but no separate rice or grain base is visible. No further hidden items are added.

STEP 5 - Totals: about 370 g of food. Energy: chicken 230 g × 1.7 ≈ 390 kcal; greens 50 g × 0.25 ≈ 13 kcal; pineapple 60 g × 0.5 ≈ 30 kcal; apple 30 g × 0.52 ≈ 16 kcal. Total ≈ 450 kcal.
